summary: S3 2017: wrong playbook parameter, green dashboard hosted on S3, four-hour cascade. Here /live and /metrics share the API process so they stay green while /ready 503s. Guardrails are worker_engine, retry cap, key prefixes — not 'be more careful'.
evidence: /live 200 with no DB; /ready 503 ~4s postgres_connect_or_query_timeout. Same process as /metrics. No external Prometheus.
JOB_PERSIST_DB default off so a typo env cannot stall every click 4s. worker_engine pool_size=2 isolated from API pool_size=5.
Invalidate only link:redirect:<code>; analytics:dedup:<job_id> survives. Postmortem (M7) must change the system, not retrain the deleter.
